narr: As the remnants of Hurricane Ida moved northeast through the Lower Ohio Valley, its moisture interacted with a near stationary cold front over southern Indiana. This produced a favorable environment for heavy rainfall which resulted in isolated flash flooding across southern Indiana and a single report in Shelby County, Kentucky. A report of severe wind damage was also received from Scott County, Kentucky.
ev: The intersection of 8th and Washington was closed due to high water.
lsr: INTERSECTION OF 8TH AND WASHINGTON CLOSED DUE TO HIGH WATER.
